brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is attending the United Nations General Assembly amid mounting international criticism of Israel's military operations, with his political future at stake domestically. The trip comes as Netanyahu faces pressure both from the international community and from Israeli voters ahead of upcoming elections.

Netanyahu's visit to the UN coincides with domestic political challenges that could determine whether he remains in power, even as he addresses global concerns about Israel's conduct.
dek: As criticism of Israel intensifies, Israeli PM Netanyahu heads to the UN with his own political future in focus.
title: Netanyahu addresses UN as Israeli election looms
